fields.to: Incident Commander (HO), Informatics Lead (IT), Lead Epidemiologist (Epi), Public Information Officer (PIO), County Counselor (Legal)
fields.subject: Signed Verification Form for IIS Export — Cyber Incident Resolution
fields.body:
Per Section 9 of the Marston County Health Department Cyber Incident Response Annex (MCHD-CYB-ANX-2026, rev 1.2) and the data-integrity verification protocol in C1, I, Dr. Joanna Pruitt, Health Officer, hereby verify that the IIS export file for 04-01 has been restored from an immutable cloud backup (04-01) and confirmed clean.

All 412 altered MMR dose records with non-existent lot numbers (MMR-2026-0044 to MMR-2026-0045) have been removed and replaced with the original, validated data. The file has been cross-checked against paper records (MCHD-F-40, MCHD-F-12), lab results (PHL-26-031882), and ColdSentry logs (VF-04, 10.72.14.08). No patient data was leaked. The system is now trusted for submission to KDHE.

This verification is authorized under MCHD-F-62 and the Cyber Incident Response Annex. All systems will now resume in the recovery order specified in C1: (1) phones and MCHD-FAX01, (2) email, (3) ClinicTrack EHR, (4) file shares and outbreak SharePoint, (5) SlotWise, (6) IIS export. The IIS-EXPORT-NIGHTLY job will restart once IT confirms network stability.

I declare this cyber incident closed.
fields.signature:
Dr. Joanna Pruitt, Health Officer
Marston County Health Department
MCHD-CYB-ANX-2026 | Decision Record: CYB-DR-1
